wiki.title: DJ Johnson (politician)
wiki.extract: Stanley D. "DJ" Johnson (born November 2, 1957) is an American politician who has served as a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives since January 2021. He represents Kentucky's 13th House district, which includes part of Daviess County.
